title: Final Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct equation for the condition of zero net intensity at point A.

title: Energy Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the conservation of energy is maintained despite the zero intensity at certain points.

title: Wave Interference
description: Important Criteria: The student must describe the concept of constructive and destructive interference in the context of sound waves.

title: Amplitude and Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention the relationship between amplitude and energy in wave phenomena.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units used in the equations and explanations are consistent and correct.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as misapplying the principle of superposition or misunderstanding nodes and antinodes.
